title: David Fravor: UFOs, Aliens, Fighter Jets, and Aerospace Engineering | Lex Fridman Podcast #122
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Navy pilot David Fravor, a primary witness of the 2004 Tic Tac UFO encounter, about the sighting, military aviation and aerospace engineering. The conversation runs close to four hours.
why: HN commenters send people here for a detailed first-hand account from the pilot, and some say it changed their view on the sightings.

quote.text: this is a great interview interesting in its own right, even without the UFO part
